experiments.study_type: Acute cholestasis induced by common bile duct ligation (BDL) in GF and ASF mice, with sham controls
experiments.procedure_text: Mice received buprenorphine before surgery; midline laparotomy under isoflurane; bile duct ligated and resected; sham animals bile duct isolated only; sacrificed 5 days after BDL.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: The bile duct was isolated from the surrounding tissues, and a 7-0 silk ligature was tied
experiments.test_system_evidence: plasma and tissues were collected for further experiments
experiments.route_evidence: 60 μg/ kg body weight of buprenorphine subcutaneously

endpoints.label: Bile infarct formation and quantification
endpoints.evidence: quantification of bile infarcts as well as Sirius red staining for determination of fibrotic tissue

endpoints.label: Liver fibrosis (Sirius red)
endpoints.evidence: Sirius red staining for determination of fibrotic tissue in the liver

endpoints.label: Ductular reaction / CK-19 cell phenotyping
endpoints.evidence: multiplex immunostaining of CK-19 in liver sections

endpoints.label: Hepatic transcriptome / DEGs
endpoints.evidence: Transcriptomic analysis of liver samples from sham-operated or BDL mice

endpoints.label: Gene expression by qPCR
endpoints.evidence: Gene expression analysis by real-time quantitative PCR

endpoints.label: Fatty acid synthesis protein / free fatty acid levels
endpoints.evidence: total-free fatty acids were measured in 10 mg of liver tissue

endpoints.label: Mitochondrial respirometry (Complex I, II, IV activity)
endpoints.evidence: The oxygen consumption rates (OCRs) in homogenates from frozen livers

endpoints.label: Plasma bile acid metabolomics
endpoints.evidence: plasma concentration of BA on an Agilent 6530 Accurate-Mass Q-TOF LC/MS

substances.name: buprenorphine
substances.evidence: 60 μg/ kg body weight of buprenorphine subcutaneously

substances.name: isoflurane
substances.evidence: Midline laparotomy was performed under isoflurane anesthesia

experiments.exposure_evidence: The animals were sacrificed 5 days after BDL
experiments.regulatory_evidence: obtained the approval of the Research Animal Ethics Committee of Canton Bern (BE66/10)
experiments.notes: Single surgical model experiment comparing GF and ASF mice with sham vs BDL cohorts; buprenorphine/isoflurane are peri-surgical agents, not the study test article.
